Maya Singh: Hi team — I'm handing in my resignation. My last day will be 2026-05-14 (two weeks). I'm on full-time benefits. What are next steps for COBRA, 401(k) rollover, and returning equipment? cc @Priya Rao @Sam Ortiz
Priya Rao: Thanks for letting us know, Maya. We'll kick off the offboard checklist. Quick bullets: health benefits end 2026-05-31 (end of month), COBRA window = 60 days from separation, 401(k) info will be emailed from Payroll with rollover options. I'll DM the benefits packet and schedule an exit interview.
Sam Ortiz: Can you list any active billing owner tasks and any scheduled on-call shifts through 05/14? We need to reassign duties and update the rota.
Maya Singh: On-call: I'm clear after 05/12. Active owners: support-runbook "payments-edge.md", recurring invoice job for partner X (cron daily 03:00 UTC), and the vendor secrets in Vault path secret/team/payments. I'll add Lina as secondary today.
Lina Gomez: I'll take over the payments invoice job and vendor secrets. Maya, please add me to the Vault ACL and the Drive folder.
IT Oncall: Re: access — default policy: SSO + GitHub + AWS keys are disabled at EOD local on last day. If you need a short overlap we can issue a temporary service account for up to 5 days with manager approval. Please file an IT ticket with exact resources.
Maya Singh: I do need a 3-day overlap for Vault handoff. Sam approves?
Sam Ortiz: Approve 3-day service account for Maya. File ticket and include repo names and Vault paths.
Priya Rao: Logistics: laptop return — we can ship a prepaid label (drop in FedEx) or schedule HQ drop-off. Facilities can also arrange same-day pickup for SF area. Please choose.
Maya Singh: I'll use prepaid label. Also, do I get a final PTO payout?
Payroll: PTO payout follows your employment agreement. For full-timers it's paid out in final payroll run; contractors vary. We'll confirm and email the exact amount. Expect final payroll within 7 business days after separation date.
Priya Rao: 401(k): Payroll will send distribution options. If you have company match vesting questions, your vesting end date is your last day (2026-05-14). For equity/RSUs contact comp@redwood.com if applicable.
Maya Singh: I'm vested for the last grant. Will comp send the numbers?
Priya Rao: Yes — comp/payroll will include final vesting accruals in your separation summary email.
Maya Singh: One more: dependent coverage — my spouse is on my plan. Will COBRA include dependents?
Priya Rao: Yes COBRA covers dependents listed on the plan at separation. We'll send the COBRA packet with election instructions to your personal email on file.
People Ops Bot: Benefits packet: https://hr.redwood.com/benefits/packet | COBRA form: https://hr.redwood.com/cobra-enroll | Offboard checklist: https://hr.redwood.com/offboards/1905554321 | Exit interview: https://cal.redwood.com/priya/exit
Facilities: For laptop returns: prepaid label will be emailed within 24 hours. If you choose drop-off, please set a 2-hour window. Badge should be placed with device and returned in box.
Maya Singh: Thanks — please send the prepaid label to my personal email (maya.singh.personal@gmail.com).
IT Oncall: Reminder: if you used local SSH keys for servers, please upload the public keys to the Drive handoff and rotate any deploy keys remaining in repos. We'll revoke access per the ticket schedule.
Lina Gomez: I'll coordinate key rotation once Maya files the ticket. Maya, please add a short checklist in payments-runbook for the key rotation steps.
Maya Singh: Will add this snippet to the runbook today:
```
# rotate deploy keys
1) create new deploy key on repo -> payments-service
2) update CI secret: ci/payments/ssh_key
3) test deploy on staging
4) remove old key from repo
```
Sam Ortiz: Can we keep mailbox forwarding for 45 days to Sam? Also set an auto-reply pointing to support@redwood.com.
Priya Rao: Yes, we'll set mailbox forwarding to sam@redwood.com for 45 days and configure the OOO template.
Payroll: Final payroll items confirmed; we'll email separation summary and 401(k) options by EOD tomorrow.
Maya Singh: Appreciate the quick coordination. I'll file the IT ticket and upload docs to Drive, then accept the exit interview invite.
Priya Rao: Thanks, Maya. We'll run the offboard and connect during the exit interview to capture feedback.
People Ops Bot: Offboard created: https://hr.redwood.com/offboards/1905554321 | Ticket placeholder will be updated when IT ticket is linked.
